thread:
Lena V: Quick note - last night a full-slab compaction overlapped with a spike and we saw p99 climb. I'm thinking a cooperative compact API with short work windows and explicit yield points.

Marco H: Agreed. Short windows (<=50ms) + a cancelable op sounds good. How do you propose signaling yields?

Lena V: Coordinator watches ingress p99 and queue depth. Allocator exposes compact_start(max_ms, priority) -> op; compact_query(op) -> progress, safe_yield; compact_cancel(op) only succeeds if safe_yield.

Dina R: Be careful: partial compaction can increase fragmentation. Define safe_yield tightly (consistent free lists). Also add reason tag for telemetry (debt_flush, scheduled).

Marco H: We should add a debt counter per-tenant that accrues when compaction is skipped; when debt high + low global load, allow longer runs.

Lena V: Yes. Also default caps: 50ms background, 200ms maintenance. Coordinator can extend op if metrics allow.

Dina R: Ops hooks: SRE can mark tenant critical to abort compaction immediately. And show compaction events in metrics.

ops-bot: Deploy note: metric stream 'allocator.compact.events' will appear in staging at 03:00 UTC.

Marco H: I'll prototype allocator stubs. Dina, can you draft a perf matrix?

Dina R: Yep — baseline vs cooperative 50ms vs 50ms + opportunistic coalesce. Collect p95/p99, bytes reclaimed, DMA churn.

Lena V: Cool. I'll open a tiny PR with interface sketches and add reviewers.
